title: Efficient Krylov solvers for inverse source problem in 2D space-time fractional diffusion equation
summary: In this work, we consider a two-dimensional time-space fractional diffusion equation with a variable coefficient and investigate the inverse source problem of reconstructing the source term f(x,y) , after regularizing the problem using the quasi-boundary value method to mitigate ill-posedness. A finite difference discretization results in a large-scale linear system with a multilevel Toeplitz-like block structure.
